how_to_pin: On a machine with legitimate access, download both files from the URLs above.
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.phase4a authenticate --kind disease --csv parkinsons.data   (must exit 0)
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.phase4a authenticate --kind risk --csv parkinsons_updrs.data (must exit 0)
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.dataset_manifest pin --name parkinsons --csv parkinsons.data
cd backend && PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.dataset_manifest pin --name parkinsons_updrs --csv parkinsons_updrs.data
Commit the updated manifest. A pin is refused for any file that does not first authenticate as the shipped training matrix.

version_history.change: added expected_columns (from code constants, not verified against the files), authentication_procedure, phase-6 access attempts; still no hash because no file was retrievable

authentication_procedure: 1. obtain the file from the publisher page (landing_page) by an authorised route; never from an unverified mirror

2. PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.phase4a authenticate --kind <disease|risk> --csv <file>   (compares the file with the shipped artifact's scaler moments; AUTHENTICATED_AS_TRAINING_DATA is required)
3. PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.dataset_manifest verify --name <parkinsons|parkinsons_updrs> --csv <file>   (structure and, once pinned, SHA-256)
4. PYTHONPATH=. python -m ml.validation.dataset_manifest pin --name <parkinsons|parkinsons_updrs> --csv <file>   (refused unless steps 2-3 pass)
